Edges link drugs given in the same trial arm. Drugs in different arms of one trial are being compared, not combined, so they are not linked.
Only arms that give Pembrolizumab are used, so every edge is part of a regimen including Pembrolizumab; other arms (e.g. control arms) are left out.
685 of 2659 trials add no edge: no arm gives Pembrolizumab with another drug.

Not linked: drugs of one class listed in the same arm, which are options rather than a combination (e.g. 'carboplatin or cisplatin'): platinum agents (141 trials), PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors (124 trials), taxanes (61 trials), fluoropyrimidines (23 trials), anthracyclines (7 trials), BRAF inhibitors (3 trials), MEK inhibitors (3 trials), EGFR inhibitors (2 trials).
Arms that list a choice of drugs ('investigator's choice') can still link options that are not in the curated list of interchangeable classes.
Placebos are not counted as drugs (found in 105 trials).
Edge weight is the number of distinct trials with that link; node weight is the number of trials linking the node to any other node.
'Pembrolizumab' is the focus: the question selects trials for it, so it is always shown and links to most other nodes.
